goal: Speed up balance calculation and coin selection for active wallets with deep transaction histories
Prevents wallet slowdowns caused by scanning large numbers of historically spent outputs
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Benchmarked massive speedups on wallets with extensive history (remyers, w0xlt, Zeegaths)
Approval after earlier cache synchronization bugs were resolved (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objections on reorg handling, db rewrite safety, and fuzz crashes (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it eliminates massive slowdowns in balance checks and coin selection for active wallets
Large synthetic wallets saw balance check speedups between 250x and 500x
